groups.criterion_quote: At least 2 years of records for prescribed goods that have been rejected and/or failed export inspection are retained

source_evidence.quote: At least 2 years of records for prescribed goods that have been rejected and/or failed export inspection are retained

groups.reason: Both provisions impose a 2-year retention obligation on different actors (authorised officer and exporter) for records related to prescribed goods. The CP criterion does not distinguish between actors or require both obligations cumulatively; it states a single retention requirement. The two rules jointly support the same benchmark requirement without establishing independent cumulative failure conditions.

rationale_summary: The two grounded norms impose parallel 2-year record retention duties on different parties. The CP criterion is a single broad requirement that does not explicitly require both duties to be independently satisfied. Therefore, they are best classified as SUPPORTS_SAME_CRITERION rather than CUMULATIVE.
